question.text: Central Bank issued Digital Currencies (CBDCs) are treated under the AML/CFT/PF guidelines as:

answer.text: Outside the scope of VDA guidance since they are digital representations of fiat currencies
Subject to the same rules as private cryptocurrencies
Completely unregulated under any financial law
Regulated only by the Weapons of Mass Destruction Act

explanation.text: The Logic: The guidelines explicitly state that CBDCs are outside the scope of the VDA guidance because they are digital representations of fiat currencies (government-issued currency not backed by a precious metal). The Trap: CBDCs are NOT treated like private cryptocurrencies and are NOT classified as VDAs for the purpose of the VDA-specific AML guidance. Note: The CBDC versus VDA scope distinction stated above is the only point that is directly grounded in the checked workbook page.
